title: Innovation-conditioned latent gain inside the GRU
question: Does conditioning a bounded latent correction gain on a causal prediction innovation improve clean-fold recurrent teacher quality or the matched standard-GRU student endpoint?

method.causal_features: normalized current row and the two preceding encoded observer measurements only
method.prior: previous latent measurement plus sigmoid(trend_logit) times the previous latent difference
method.innovation: current latent measurement minus local-linear prior; zero if no prior row exists
method.injection: zero-initialized residual projections of posterior and gain-weighted innovation into ordinary fused GRU input and readout
method.observer_state: last two latent measurements and seen-row count; carried across chunks; reset at sequence boundaries
method.classification: KalmanNet-inspired learned latent observer; not calibrated Bayesian filtering and not test-time weight adaptation

teacher_arms.role: matched parameter/control arm; gain MLP receives current latent context but zero innovation

teacher_primary_contrasts.estimand: equal-fold mean of paired cell WP deltas
equal-fold mean of paired cell WP deltas
equal-fold mean of paired cell WP deltas

student_arms.cache: replace only samefold_baseline with paired context-only observer teacher
replace only samefold_baseline with paired innovation observer teacher

student_cache.replace_coefficient: exactly preserve the existing cell-specific samefold_baseline coefficient
student_cache.other_sources: same run ids, epochs and coefficients in all cache conditions
student_cache.admission: freeze and verify clean-fold fit membership, ancestor closure, checkpoint/provenance hashes, prediction sidecars, split hash, epochs, coefficient table and row order before any student fit
student_cache.student_target: 0.5 * original labels + 0.5 * source-scale four-family cache target

teacher_training.train_source: train+valid, restricted by source-qualified outer-fold manifest
teacher_training.scheduler: OneCycle over identical exact update budget
teacher_training.precision: strict FP32; autocast, TF32 and quantization disabled
teacher_training.sampling: same seed, fold membership and deterministic order within each paired cell
teacher_training.fit_time_evaluation: off; export frozen predictions after fit

student_training.precision: strict FP32; autocast, TF32 and quantization disabled

statistics.seed_bootstrap: 10,000 draws of the eight shared seed identities with identical multiplicities across folds and renormalization over each fold available cells
statistics.component_bootstrap: 10,000 paired source-component draws within each fold; same component multiplicities for all arms and seeds
statistics.multiplicity_correction: Holm across the frozen confirmatory comparison family if all declared contrasts are reported
statistics.claim_scope: four exposed folds, source-qualified components, fixed training recipes; not pristine-holdout, unseen-regime or public leaderboard uncertainty
statistics.practical_reference: about +0.0005 WP is a provisional follow-up priority reference only; not a universal success threshold or kill gate

scale_ladder.status: bounded profile, then follow-up matched cells if compute allows
profile and follow-up when H512 evidence is useful or uncertain with information value

compute.hardware_target: 8 x NVIDIA B300; verify exact topology, driver, CUDA and PyTorch on handoff host
compute.parallelism: up to eight independent fits, one visible B300 per process
compute.ddp: not used for primary cells; no DDP implementation in this adapter
compute.profile_gate: one actual B300, actual data loader and full H512/B16/chunk2000 shape; one warm-up plus four measured batches before fit matrix

leakage_controls: observer reads only current and previous two encoded input rows

predictor/cache source hashes bind observer and GRU core code
student cache ancestry and exact coefficient replacement frozen before student fit
